        <parent link="world" />
        <child link="base_link" />
        <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0" />
    </joint>

joints.name: diagnostic_tcp_fixed

modifications: removed massless virtual aperture joint; physical fingers retained and mimic implemented in action mapping
visual DAE replaced by matching upstream STL
added massless fixed diagnostic TCP at gripper_base z=0.18m; diagnostic reference, not manufacturer calibration
simulation_gains: arm Kp=2000 Kd=100 effort<=100Nm; fingers Kp=1000 Kd=50 effort<=10N; simulation tuning only
